rationale: The failed-gap short thesis remains intact — price holds below session VWAP ($54.11) and the 9-EMA, the heaviest recent 1-minute candle was a distribution bar making new lows at $53.48, and the subsequent bounce came on trivial volume with SPY red and VIXY green and no new headlines. The trade is in profit with MFE exceeding MAE, and the $54.42 invalidation above VWAP still cleanly bounds risk against the $52.65 target, so closing now would just pay the 24bp spread to harvest a fraction of the expected move. Flipping long would be a counter-trend scalp against the tape with no meaningful supporting evidence, so the correct action is to hold the short.
